tart_intro: TART is the collaborative platform this archive runs on, for documenting and preserving the history of urban art. Each local archive is independent and run by its own community.
tart_licence_text: The TART software is source-available and freely available for non-commercial use, under this licence:
tart_licence_scope: The software licence covers neither the TART name and logo, nor this archive's data, nor contributors' content, nor the artworks.
tart_credits_empty: This version of TART includes no third-party assets.

sign_in_intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a code to sign in. There is no password.

sign_in_registration_invite: New accounts are by invitation only: use the address your invitation was sent to.

sign_in_register_intro: There is no account for {email} yet: two more things and you are in.

sign_in_passkey_hint: No passkey yet? Sign in with the code and add one on the Account page.

account_name_intro: It is shown next to your contributions, past ones included. It can be a pseudonym.

account_error_email_unchanged: This is already your email address.

account_passkey_name_hint: To recognise it in the list, for example “Phone” or “Laptop”. 1 to 40 characters.
